description: Search unclaimed money and uncashed checks by owner name or property ID, or browse a state's public register. Sources include California and Iowa statewide files plus municipal open-data registers.

dateFrom.description: Earliest check/warrant issue date (YYYY-MM-DD). Only sources that disclose dates are searched; California's statewide file has no date field and is skipped.
dateFrom.title: Date from

iaFiscalYear.description: Which Iowa DAS outdated-warrant file(s) to read. `Latest` is the newest posted fiscal year.
iaFiscalYear.title: Iowa fiscal year

includeUnknownAmount.description: When an amount filter is active, also keep records whose source publishes no dollar amount (for example City of Austin, TX).
includeUnknownAmount.title: Include records with no disclosed amount

jurisdiction.description: Narrow to one specific government source (useful when a state has more than one, e.g. California or Massachusetts). 'All jurisdictions' queries every source in the selected state(s).
enumTitles: All jurisdictions in the selected state(s)
City of Austin, TX — Unclaimed Property (Municipal)
City of Corpus Christi, TX — Unclaimed Property (Municipal)
City of Providence, RI — Uncashed Municipal Check
Marin County, CA — Uncashed County Check
City of Roseville, CA — Stale-Dated Check (Municipal)
California State Controller — Statewide Unclaimed Property
Montgomery County, MD — Unclaimed Vendor Payment (County)
Town of Framingham, MA — Unclaimed Payroll Check (Municipal)
Town of Framingham, MA — Unclaimed Resident/Vendor/AP Check (Municipal)
State of Iowa (DAS) — Outdated State Warrant
jurisdiction.title: Jurisdiction

maxAmountUsd.description: Only include records worth at most this much. Leave unset for no maximum.
maxAmountUsd.title: Maximum amount (USD)

minAmountUsd.description: Only include records worth at least this much. 0 = no minimum. When an amount filter is active, records whose source discloses no amount are excluded unless `includeUnknownAmount` is on.
minAmountUsd.title: Minimum amount (USD)

mode.description: search: find records by owner name or property ID. browse: list a register without a name filter. byPropertyId: exact property/warrant/check lookup.
mode.title: Mode

ownerName.description: Full or partial owner/payee name (case-insensitive). Words can be in any order and commas are ignored, so `Smith, John` and `John Smith` both work.
ownerName.title: Owner name

propertyId.description: Exact property ID, warrant number or check number. Works in every mode; `byPropertyId` is the dedicated lookup mode.
propertyId.title: Property ID

propertyType.description: Broad property-type group. California's 190 raw NAUPA codes are mapped into these groups; use `propertyTypeContains` for an exact raw-string filter.
propertyType.title: Property type

propertyTypeContains.description: Advanced: keep only records whose raw source type contains this text, e.g. `Dividend` or `Endowment`. Combined with the group filter.
propertyTypeContains.title: Raw property type contains

sortBy.description: How to order results. `relevance` preserves source and file order. Records missing the chosen field sink to the bottom.
sortBy.title: Sort by

state.description: Which state's unclaimed-property source(s) to query. 'All states' fans out to every supported source in one run.
state.title: State

valueRange.description: Which California State Controller archive to scan for browsing and name searches. Exact property-ID lookups scan all four ranges (smallest first) so lower balances are not missed, then stop at the matching range. `All value ranges` scans four range files one at a time and is much heavier than the default.
valueRange.title: California value range

title: US Unclaimed Property Scraper Input
